title: Runnable Composition
summary: This module provides core components for composing and orchestrating runnables, enabling dynamic configuration, chat history management, input/output manipulation, and integration with external runnable sources or function-based routing.

nodes.label: Dynamically Configure Runnable
nodes.title: DynamicRunnable
nodes.description: Enables a Runnable to be dynamically configured at runtime, allowing for flexible execution paths or component swapping based on input or environment.

nodes.label: Manage Chat Message History
nodes.title: RunnableWithMessageHistory
nodes.description: Wraps another Runnable to automatically load, update, and persist chat message history, maintaining conversational context across interactions.

nodes.label: Pass Through or Augment Input
nodes.title: RunnablePassthrough
nodes.description: Allows inputs to pass through a chain unchanged, or to be augmented with additional keys, useful for structuring data flow and intermediate results.

nodes.label: Load Runnable from LangChain Hub
nodes.title: HubRunnable
nodes.description: Fetches and executes a Runnable definition from the LangChain Hub, enabling dynamic integration of community or privately shared components.

nodes.label: Route Based on OpenAI Functions
nodes.title: OpenAIFunctionsRouter
nodes.description: Directs execution to different sub-runnables based on the output of an OpenAI function call, facilitating tool use and conditional logic.

nodes.label: Base Runnable Abstraction
nodes.title: Runnable / RunnableSerializable
nodes.description: The fundamental interface for all executable components in LangChain, defining methods for invocation, streaming, batching, and configuration.

nodes.label: Chat Message History Store
nodes.title: BaseChatMessageHistory
nodes.description: An interface for storing and retrieving conversational messages, used to maintain context across turns in a dialogue.

nodes.label: LangChain Hub Service
nodes.title: LangChain Hub
nodes.description: An external service for sharing and discovering LangChain components and runnables.

nodes.label: OpenAI Function Call Output
nodes.title: OpenAI Function Call
nodes.description: Structured output from an OpenAI model indicating a function to be called, including its name and arguments.

groups.label: Generative Composition
groups.title: Generative Composition
groups.description: Components that dynamically select or generate the execution path or component based on configuration or external signals.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management
groups.description: Components focused on managing and integrating specific types of data within runnable chains, such as conversational history.

groups.label: Surface-Level Manipulation
groups.title: Surface-Level Manipulation
groups.description: Components that directly influence the flow and structure of inputs and outputs within a runnable chain without altering core logic.
